latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Product Launch Playbook.

- Provides a comprehensive guide for launching AI products globally in 2025-2026.
- Covers AI product positioning, messaging, and proven launch strategies.
- Includes case studies from leading AI products like Manus, Devin, and ChatGPT-era launches.
- Features AI-specific marketing tactics, launch channels, and influencer outreach.
- Offers guidance on managing AI hype, skepticism, and post-launch iteration.
- Multi-language support for global go-to-market strategies.
